The portal files it under the publisher Alimentación para el Bienestar S.A. de C.V. (ALIMENTACION BIENESTAR). Its tags are agricultor, agricultura, agricultura subsistencia, catálogo, cereal. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-03-12 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
